# 🗿 The Gadyn by Anoosh 🗿

Prepare your ultimate armor and weapons for an ancient encounter! **The Gadyn by Anoosh** introduces a towering, mysterious titan into your Minecraft world. Roaming the lands silently, this giant structure of pure power will not bother you unless you make the mistake of striking it. But beware—waking this sleeping giant triggers a brutal fight for survival.

---

## ✨ Features

* **🌍 Natural Titan Spawning:** The Gadyn naturally spawns across the overworld, adding a majestic yet intimidating presence to your world.
* **⚔️ Titan-Class Stats:** This is a true test of strength! The Gadyn boasts a massive health pool of **100+ HP** and deals a devastating **20+ Attack Damage** per hit. 
* **🧘 Neutral Until Provoked:** He won't attack you on sight. You can walk right past him safely—but once you attack him, his wrath is unleashed.
* **🏆 Legendary Rewards & XP:** Conquering this titan yields unmatched rewards. Defeating The Gadyn unlocks the exclusive **"Meet the Gadyn" Advancement** and drops a staggering **5000 Experience Points (XP)** to fuel your enchantments!

---

## 🛠️ Installation & Support
1. Download and install the required library mod (see below).
2. Download the correct version of **The Gadyn by Anoosh** for your Mod Loader (Forge/Fabric/NeoForge).
3. Drop both `.jar` files into your Minecraft `mods` folder.
4. Explore your world and decide if you are brave enough to challenge the titan!

---

## ⛔ Requirements (🚨 REQUIRED DEPENDENCY 🚨)

To ensure this massive titan's custom 3D model and animations render flawlessly without any game crashes, you **MUST** install the following dependency:

* **[GeckoLib on CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/geckolib)**
* **[GeckoLib on Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib/versions)**

*Note: Please ensure you download the version of GeckoLib that exactly matches your game version and mod loader!*
